text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Justice Minister Dughmi says U.S. judicial team coming to Jordan to discuss the case of former Hamas political chief Abu Marzook, who may be released from New York jail.
- Planning Ministry developing 400 million dinar ($565 million) social safety net for Jordan's poor over the next six years.
- Crown Prince Hassan returns to Jordan after visits to France and Switzerland. Says Jordan is trying to help rebuild the Middle East economy.
- Discussions on Jordan-EU partnership have reached an advanced stage, progress made on patents, intellectual property, industry and agriculture; more discussion needed on issue of repatriations.
- Four teams set up by planning ministry have presented their outlines for implementing social safety net for the poor.
- King Hussein in London speech calls for concerted world effort to advance Middle East peace process; Crown Prince Hassan ends Swiss visit with focus on peace and economy.
- Hamas leader Abu Marzook's possible destination unclear yet.
